title: What the Abstention Option Measures: Refusal Loss, Sampling Churn, and Option Capture in Distilled Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.28639v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Small instruction-tuned language models reach phones, cars, and offline assistants through knowledge distillation, and whether a distilled model is fair enough to ship is often decided by a multiple-choice bias score on a benchmark that offers an abstention option. Three mechanisms move behavior around the abstention option: refusal loss, where the student stops declining on items its pre-distillation reference declined; sampling churn, the same change observed between two runs of the reference itself; and option capture, where the student takes an abstention option whenever one is offered. Injecting each mechanism into a reference's own records shows that aggregate scores see only outright loss, per-item scores see churn and remapping, and only conditioning on committed answers stops moved refusal mass from reading as fairness. Resampling a reference across inference seeds already turns 10% to 27% of its refusals into stereoty

translated_title: 弃权选项衡量了什么：蒸馏小型语言模型中的拒绝损失、采样波动与选项捕获
translated_abstract: 通过知识蒸馏，小型指令微调语言模型被部署到手机、汽车和离线助手中，而一个蒸馏出的模型是否足够公平、可以发布，通常由基准测试中的多项选择偏见分数决定，该基准提供了弃权选项。有三种机制会改变模型围绕弃权选项的行为：拒绝损失，即学生模型在其蒸馏前参考模型曾拒绝的项目上不再拒绝；采样波动，即在参考模型自身的两次运行之间观察到的相同变化；以及选项捕获，即学生模型在提供弃权选项时倾向于选择该选项。将每种机制注入参考模型自身的记录中表明，聚合分数只能看到彻底的拒绝损失，逐项分数则能看到波动和重映射，而只有以已提交的答案为条件，才能避免被移动的拒绝数量被误读为公平性。仅在不同推理种子下对参考模型进行重采样，就已经会使其10%到27%的拒绝变成刻板印象答案。
tldr: 该研究将蒸馏小型语言模型在偏见基准弃权选项上的行为变化分解为拒绝损失、采样波动和选项捕获三种机制，并证明聚合分数仅能反映拒绝损失，只有以已提交答案为条件进行评估，才能避免将拒绝行为的移动误读为公平性的提升。
en_tdlr: This work decomposes behavior shifts around the abstention option in distilled small language models into refusal loss, sampling churn, and option capture, showing that aggregate scores only capture outright loss and that only conditioning on committed answers prevents moved refusal mass from being misread as fairness.
